discussion_comments.comment_body:
Verified by generation: the resulting dll-Help.xml has -Ttl required="true" for Fields/Object/TmFields/TmObject and required="false" for AliasFields/AliasObject, which matches the intent.
  - Existing precedent in this repo: 385 parameter headings across 8,455 help files use 2+ yaml blocks; the 3+ block pattern (same as here) exists today in e.g. Set-AzFirewallPolicy.md (-Location), Complete-AzSqlInstanceDatabaseCopy.md (-InstanceName, -ResourceGroupName), Complete-AzSqlInstanceDatabaseMove.md, etc.
 
 Collapsing to one block would force a single Required: value, which would either incorrectly mark -Ttl as required for alias sets (breaking existing behavior) or incorrectly mark it as optional for TMLink sets (the TMLink service-side requirement is what this PR is specifically wiring up). Will leave as-is — happy to discuss if I'm misunderstanding.
